plane_ratio.caveat: the two grids cover different areas; canopy measured 20 min earlier (7 min after lights-on vs 27) so LED warm-up may inflate it

lamp_model_fit.method: 3 parallel bars (5 cm apart) as finite line sources at 23 cm, least squares on the 30 rim points
lamp_model_fit.conclusion: a compact source alone cannot reproduce the field; ~60% of the light at the rim plane is diffuse/reflected (white enclosure). Lamp position is NOT identified by this data (fit runs to the search bounds).

nutrient.interpretation: 20 min is far too short for evaporation to concentrate the solution ~10%. The rise is salt released from the medium (previously accumulated + vermiculite cation exchange). The medium is a SOURCE here, not only a sink.
